message:
feat(source): check exhaustive constructor matches with dependent results and recursive data

Connect native match syntax and the existing bounded term task machine to
ordinary checked recursors. Preserve every branch, real constructor
payloads, local scopes, type annotations and hidden recursion arguments.
Support nested matches, branch lets, catch-alls, source variants, Nat
literals, dependent records and proof-valued results.

Observed locally: 1337 tests passed across all five affected packages,
zero failed/ignored; Clippy and all-target workspace compilation passed.
The publication workflow repeats those gates and checks the installed CLI
example before a non-forced fast-forward. No whole-workspace test or full
Lean match/equation-compiler parity is claimed.
